assumptions.choice: Build 4H and 1D OHLCV bars inside the strategy from the single 1H feed, using civil-date boundaries and four-hour buckets beginning at hours 00, 04, 08, 12, 16, and 20.
assumptions.reason: The harness supplies only one 1H data feed and does not supply separate 4H or daily feeds.

assumptions.choice: A consolidation is the three completed bars immediately before an impulse; its boundaries are the minimum low and maximum high of those bars.
assumptions.reason: The specification does not define the length or algorithm for a period of consolidation.

assumptions.choice: A sharp rise is an impulse close at least 1% above the consolidation upper boundary, and a sharp fall is an impulse close at least 1% below its lower boundary; impulse volume must exceed the three-bar consolidation's average volume.
assumptions.reason: The specification requires an algorithm based on price extremes and volume but does not quantify sharpness or the volume test.

assumptions.choice: Test the required zone height against 0.5% of the impulse bar close.
assumptions.reason: The specification says 0.5% of the asset price without selecting a particular price.

assumptions.choice: Keep every detected 1D and 4H zone for the remainder of the run, without invalidation.
assumptions.reason: The specification gives no invalidation or expiration rule.

assumptions.choice: Use each 1H input candle for entry refinement. A demand bounce means the candle overlaps the zone, reaches its midpoint or lower half, and closes above the midpoint; a supply bounce is the symmetric condition.
assumptions.reason: The specification permits 1H refinement but does not mathematically define enters or bounces from the lower boundary or central part.

assumptions.choice: Define the completed daily trend as up when the latest completed daily close is above the prior completed daily close, down when below, and neutral when equal.
assumptions.reason: The specification requires a daily trend direction but gives no trend algorithm.
The RSI confirmation is explicitly optional.

assumptions.choice: Submit a market order after the qualifying candle, which Backtrader fills at the next available open.
assumptions.reason: The specification explicitly permits entry at the open of the next candle.

assumptions.choice: For a long signal choose the entered demand zone with the highest upper boundary; for a short signal choose the entered supply zone with the lowest lower boundary.
assumptions.reason: The specification does not resolve simultaneous overlap of multiple zones.

assumptions.choice: For longs, the nearest higher supply zone is the qualifying zone with the lowest lower boundary above the signal close; for shorts, the nearest lower demand zone has the highest upper boundary below the signal close. The target is that facing boundary.
assumptions.reason: The specification does not define nearest or which boundary constitutes reaching a target zone.

assumptions.choice: Risk 1% of current total broker value, using integer units based on signal close to stop distance.
assumptions.reason: The allowed range is 1-2%, but the exact percentage, capital valuation point, and fractional-unit policy are not specified.

assumptions.choice: After entry fills, submit OCO stop and limit orders at the precomputed stop and target prices.
assumptions.reason: The specification requires stop-loss and take-profit exits but does not define order mechanics; the target and risk sizing are determined at the entry signal close.
